def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The two same-colored border segments are the endpoints of parallel rays.
    for axis in (0, 1):  # 0: segments on left/right; 1: top/bottom
        if axis == 0:
            edges = ([grid[r][0] for r in range(h)],
                     [grid[r][w - 1] for r in range(h)])
            cross = w
        else:
            edges = ([grid[0][c] for c in range(w)],
                     [grid[h - 1][c] for c in range(w)])
            cross = h

        spans = []
        for edge in edges:
            cells = [(i, color) for i, color in enumerate(edge) if color != bg]
            if not cells:
                spans = []
                break
            bar = Counter(color for _, color in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
            indices = [i for i, color in cells if color == bar]
            spans.append((bar, min(indices), max(indices)))
        if len(spans) != 2 or spans[0][0] != spans[1][0]:
            continue

        bar_color = spans[0][0]
        markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != bar_color]
        if not markers:
            return out
        ray_color = Counter(color for _, _, color in markers).most_common(1)[0][0]

        for r, c, _ in markers:
            p = r if axis == 0 else c
            side = next((s for s, (_, lo, hi) in enumerate(spans)

            if side is None:

            offset = p - spans[side][1]
            other = 1 - side
            paired_p = spans[other][1] + offset
            if paired_p > spans[other][2]:

            # Ray from this marker back to its own border. The marker is

                if (rr, cc) == (r, c):

                if grid[rr][cc] != bar_color:

            # Matching ray from the opposite bar spans the full grid width.
            for q in range(cross):
                if axis == 0:
                    rr, cc = paired_p, (q if other == 0 else w - 1 - q)
                else:
